fields.cause_of_death: Cardiopulmonary arrest secondary to acute myocardial infarction

narrative_blocks: This official document certifies that the death of Arthur Pendelton occurred on November 4, 2022, in Toronto, Ontario. The death was registered under registration number DC-2022-883921 on November 7, 2022.
Issued under the authority of the Vital Statistics Act by the Office of the Registrar General of Ontario. The document bears the official seal and authorized signature of the Registrar General.

cases.title: Certificado de Defunción - Registro Civil de Santiago
cases.issuing_authority: Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificación, Chile

fields.issuing_authority_seal: Sello Oficial del Registro Civil de Santiago
fields.proof_of_marital_status: Foreign Death Certificate submitted in Spanish without translation

narrative_blocks: Certificado de Defunción emitido por el Registro Civil de Santiago. Se certifica el fallecimiento de Mateo Silva ocurrido el 12 de marzo de 2023.

El documento fue expedido en idioma español y entregado a la autoridad migratoria en su versión original sin adjuntar traducción al inglés o francés ni la correspondiente declaración jurada del traductor.

defect_spec.description: The foreign language death certificate was submitted without a certified English or French translation, missing the required translator affidavit and official translator credentials or seal.

cases.title: Unverified Record of Death
narrative_blocks: This record states that Robert Vance passed away on January 14, 2023. However, the document lacks an official registration tracking or reference number.
The space designated for the official seal of the issuing authority and the signature of the civil registrar remains completely blank, rendering the document legally unverified.

defect_spec.description: The submitted death certificate lacks mandatory authenticity markers, specifically missing the official civil registrar seal, authorized signature, and official registration entry number.

cases.title: Death Registration Extract - Civil Status Office

fields.marital_status_declaration: Applicant declared spouse Carlos Gomez (DOB 1962-07-25) in Express Entry, but submitted certificate for brother Carlos Eduardo Gomez Ruiz (DOB 1960-03-12)
fields.proof_of_marital_status: Death Certificate with mismatched identity details

narrative_blocks: Death certificate issued for Carlos Eduardo Gomez Ruiz, born March 12, 1960. The document indicates the applicant's relationship to the deceased as sibling.
Express Entry profile records list the applicant's spouse as Carlos Gomez born July 25, 1962, introducing critical discrepancies in full legal name, date of birth, and declared familial relationship.

defect_spec.description: Significant identity discrepancies exist between the submitted death certificate and Express Entry profile data regarding the deceased's full name, date of birth, and declared relationship to the applicant.

cases.title: Undisclosed Marital Status Change Evidence File

fields.marital_status_declaration: Declared Married in e-APR submission post-ITA despite spouse passing
fields.family_composition: Primary Applicant and Accompanying Spouse (Spouse deceased post-ITA but undisclosed)
fields.proof_of_marital_status: Omitted - Death certificate not provided post-ITA

narrative_blocks: The applicant received an Invitation to Apply (ITA) as Married. Following the passing of spouse David Miller post-ITA, the applicant submitted the e-APR maintaining the 'MARRIED' status code.
The applicant failed to disclose the change in marital status to Widowed and omitted the mandatory death certificate from the post-ITA document submission package.

defect_spec.description: The applicant failed to declare a post-ITA change in marital status following the death of their spouse and omitted the required death certificate evidence, leaving family composition inaccurate.
